discussion_comments.comment_body: This duplicates existing code. `core/services/cloud-handoff/git-preflight.ts` (#15219) already normalizes the remote and checks the branch and upstream, and `createWorkspaceGitReader` in `workspace-manifest.ts` already reads remotes and refs. Please reuse those, or put this snapshot logic in core next to `git-preflight` instead of keeping a second git runner in the app.

Moved the snapshot/publication implementation into core beside `git-preflight` in merged #15371, and reused `normalizeGitHubRemoteUrl`. Desktop no longer owns a second Git runner. The core snapshot path still needs Git operations beyond manifest discovery, including an isolated index, captured tree, unpublished-history checks, and publication of the approved commit.

Import the existing check from `@cline/shared`. `node:path` isn't needed after this change.

```suggestion
import {
	augmentNodeCommandForDebug,
	getShellKind,
	withResolvedClineBuildEnv,
```

`getShellKind` in `@cline/shared` already does this check, so this function can go.


follow up: suggest moving resolveSessionListTitle into @cline/core/src/services/session-data/ or similar, then:

- Replace SDK's inferTitleFromMessages() calls with it
- Update desktop-app to import from SDK instead of local session-data/common

That keeps the logic centralized while respecting the dependency graph (apps can depend on @cline/core, but not vice versa).
